title: Vida cotidiana
goal: Read about everyday food, clothing and games before 1492, and explain a food-science trick Europe didn't understand for centuries.

items: Explain what nixtamalization is and why it mattered.
Explain why pellagra appeared in Europe after maize did.
Describe how chocolate functioned among the Mexica beyond being a drink.
Describe one way clothing signalled social rank in the Inca empire.
Use the gerund to describe two actions happening at once, or a method.
I can explain what nixtamalization is and why it mattered.
I can explain why pellagra appeared in Europe after maize did.
I can describe how chocolate functioned among the Mexica beyond being a drink.
I can describe one way clothing signalled social rank in the Inca empire.
I can use the gerund to describe two actions happening at once, or a method.
